'''Sable City''' (Japanese: '''サビシティ''' ''Sabi City'') is a small {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town located in [[Kanto]], very close to [[Pewter City]].

In ''[[AG176|The Ole' Berate and Switch!]]'', Sable City held a one-day Pokémon Tournament, in which {{Ash}} entered to train for his upcoming match at the [[Battle Pyramid]]. Ash participated with his {{AP|Corphish}}, who helped him win against [[Howie]] and [[Oriba]]. However, [[Max]] accidentally discovered that [[Team Rocket]]'s [[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]] had created the event as a scheme to steal all the competitors' Pokémon and give them to {{an|Giovanni|the Boss}}. Ash and {{ashfr}} joined forces with the other Trainers to defeat the plot, while the [[Team Rocket trio]] helped and decided to get their revenge on rivals Butch and Cassidy.
